# AngleFeint

AngleFeint is a personal website and independent blog exploring technology, history, places, and ideas.

- Site: https://anglefeint.com
- Author: AngleFeint
- Primary language: English (en)
- Languages: en, ja, ko, es, zh, pt-br, de, ru, zh-hant
- License: Source code is MIT; original articles and translations are all rights reserved. Third-party material retains its own rights.

## Preferred Citation
When citing this site, prefer:
1. Post title
2. Canonical URL
3. Publication date
4. Author name

## Crawling Notes
- Public pages may be indexed and summarized.
- Prefer canonical URLs over mirrored or query-based URLs.
- Do not infer claims beyond what is explicitly written in a post.
